grid.axes: Galactic X (to the Galactic centre), Y (rotation), Z (north), the Sun at the origin

density.unit: differential extinction per parsec, E of Zhang, Green & Rix (2023)

sampling.weight: cell density, capped at its 99.7th percentile (2.761e-03)

sources.map: Edenhofer G. et al. 2024, A&A 685, A82 (arXiv:2308.01295); Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8187943, mean_and_std_xyz.fits (15 662 543 040 B), CC BY 4.0
sources.bubble: O'Neill T.J., Zucker C., Goodman A.A., Edenhofer G. 2024, ApJ 973, 138 (arXiv:2403.04961): the shell at 170 pc on average, 70 to 600+ pc, typically 35 pc thick
sources.gaia: ESA/Gaia/DPAC, Gaia DR3 (the extinctions' stars); CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO

licence: Edenhofer et al. 2024 map: CC BY 4.0; built from Gaia DR3, CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO (ESA)
